name: Open-front metric hex-key rack
description: Nine upright L-keys, 1.5–10 mm. Short arms rest on the floor. Lift 9 mm and pull forward through the open guides.

name: Tape-measure dock
description: A shallow open dock for a tape measure up to 92 mm across and 48 mm deep including its clip. Lift 10 mm and pull forward.

name: Coiled test-lead hanger
description: A broad saddle and raised nose hold coiled test leads or USB cables. Lift the coil over the nose and pull forward.
